column1: # The painted skill effects (Docs/PLAN.md *Skills that look like themselves*).
# name <TAB> kind (sheet = 4x4 flipbook, single = one image) <TAB> the effect.
# tools/skill_fx.py paints each missing one with Meshy's painter under the shared
# style line (PREFIX in the tool), then tools/vfx_sheets.py ships the sheets.

column3: a fire impact explosion seen from the front, as a blow of fire magic lands. Frames 1 to 2: a small white-hot flash at the centre. Frames 3 to 6: a ball of orange flame bursts outward with licking tongues of fire and a ring of sparks. Frames 7 to 11: the fireball billows larger, turning deep red-orange, embers flying outward. Frames 12 to 16: it breaks into curling smoke wisps and dying embers and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a curved crescent slash of fire sweeping from the upper right down to the lower left, a blade trail made of flame. Frames 1 to 3: the crescent streaks across with a white-hot leading edge. Frames 4 to 8: it blazes at full length with flames licking off its outer edge and sparks flying. Frames 9 to 16: it breaks into embers along its length and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a fireball projectile flying to the right, seen from the side: a white-hot core wrapped in swirling orange flame with a tail of fire and embers streaming behind it to the left. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the burning fireball in flight, the flames flickering and swirling, the fireball the same size and in the same place in every cell.

a pillar of fire erupting from the ground, the base at the bottom centre of each cell. Frames 1 to 3: a glowing crack and a spray of sparks at the bottom. Frames 4 to 8: a tall column of roaring flame shoots upward to the top of the cell. Frames 9 to 12: it billows at full height. Frames 13 to 16: it collapses into embers and smoke and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a flaming meteor falling from the sky onto the ground. Frames 1 to 4: a burning rock with a long fiery tail streaks down from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes the bottom centre in a white-hot flash. Frames 8 to 12: a dome of fire and flying rock debris bursts outward from the impact. Frames 13 to 16: smoke and embers fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a ring shockwave of fire spreading across the ground, seen from directly above. Frames 1 to 3: a small bright ring of flame at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin fiery ring throwing embers, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring thins, breaks into sparks and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.

a swirling aura of rising flames around an invisible standing figure: the centre of each cell stays dark and empty, flames and embers spiral upward around it from the bottom. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a magic circle of fire seen from directly above: concentric rings of glowing orange-gold runes and flame glyphs, a six-pointed ember star at the centre, thin bright engraved lines, perfectly symmetric, the circle filling the image.

a splash of water and ice exploding at the centre as a blow of water magic lands. Frames 1 to 2: a white flash with a burst of droplets. Frames 3 to 7: a crown of deep blue water splashes outward with sparkling ice shards. Frames 8 to 12: droplets and cold mist spread outward. Frames 13 to 16: the mist fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a curved crescent slash of rushing water sweeping from the upper right down to the lower left, a blade trail of water with glittering ice crystals along its edge. Frames 1 to 3: the crescent streaks across with a bright white leading edge. Frames 4 to 8: it surges at full length, spray flying off it. Frames 9 to 16: it breaks into droplets and mist and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a spinning orb of swirling water with an icy white core, flying to the right, droplets and a spray trail streaming behind it to the left. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the orb in flight, the water swirling, the orb the same size and in the same place in every cell.

a geyser of water with jagged ice spikes erupting from the ground, the base at the bottom centre of each cell. Frames 1 to 3: the ground cracks with blue light and spray. Frames 4 to 8: a tall column of water and ice spikes shoots upward. Frames 9 to 12: spray and ice shards burst from its top. Frames 13 to 16: it collapses into mist and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a giant spear of ice falling from the sky onto the ground. Frames 1 to 4: a long glowing ice spear with a trail of frost streaks down from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes the bottom centre in a white flash. Frames 8 to 12: it shatters into a burst of ice shards and cold mist. Frames 13 to 16: the mist fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a ring of water ripples and ice crystals spreading across the ground, seen from directly above. Frames 1 to 3: a small bright ring of water at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin glittering ring of spray and frost, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring thins into droplets and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.

a swirling aura of water currents and snowflakes rising around an invisible standing figure: the centre of each cell stays dark and empty, ribbons of water and frost spiral upward around it. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a magic circle of water and ice seen from directly above: concentric rings of glowing cyan runes and wave glyphs, a snowflake star at the centre, thin bright engraved lines, perfectly symmetric, the circle filling the image.

a burst of cutting wind at the centre as a blow of wind magic lands: pale green and white curved wind blades and speed streaks explode outward with torn leaves. Frames 1 to 2: a white flash. Frames 3 to 7: the wind blades fan out spinning. Frames 8 to 12: streaks and leaves swirl outward. Frames 13 to 16: they fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a curved crescent slash of wind sweeping from the upper right down to the lower left: a sharp pale green-white blade of compressed air with speed streaks and a few leaves. Frames 1 to 3: the crescent streaks across with a bright leading edge. Frames 4 to 8: it cuts at full length, streaks peeling off it. Frames 9 to 16: it frays into wisps and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a spinning crescent blade of compressed wind flying to the right like a boomerang of air, pale green and white, speed streaks trailing behind it to the left. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the spinning blade in flight, the same size and in the same place in every cell.

a tornado rising from the ground, the base at the bottom centre of each cell: a funnel of swirling pale green and white wind with leaves and dust. Frames 1 to 3: a swirl of dust and leaves at the bottom. Frames 4 to 8: the funnel spins up to the top of the cell. Frames 9 to 12: it spins at full height. Frames 13 to 16: it unravels into wisps and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a vortex of wind blades descending from the sky onto the ground. Frames 1 to 4: a spiral of pale green wind blades and a thin crackle of lightning drops from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes the bottom centre in a white flash. Frames 8 to 12: a burst of wind blades and torn leaves spirals outward from the impact. Frames 13 to 16: the wisps fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a ring of wind gusts spreading across the ground, seen from directly above, with leaves caught in it. Frames 1 to 3: a small bright swirl at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin ring of pale green wind streaks, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring frays and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.

a swirling aura of wind currents and leaves rising around an invisible standing figure: the centre of each cell stays dark and empty, pale green streaks and leaves spiral upward around it. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a magic circle of wind seen from directly above: concentric rings of glowing pale green runes, spiral and feather glyphs, a four-pointed swirl star at the centre, thin bright engraved lines, perfectly symmetric, the circle filling the image.

a holy explosion of light at the centre as a blow of light magic lands: a golden starburst with long radiating rays and sparkles. Frames 1 to 2: a white flash. Frames 3 to 7: golden rays and a bright ring burst outward. Frames 8 to 12: sparkles and feathers of light drift outward. Frames 13 to 16: the glow fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a curved crescent slash of golden light sweeping from the upper right down to the lower left, a blade trail of holy light with sparkles. Frames 1 to 3: the crescent streaks across with a white-hot leading edge. Frames 4 to 8: it shines at full length, motes of light rising off it. Frames 9 to 16: it dissolves into golden sparkles and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a lance of golden holy light flying to the right, a bright white core with a golden spear-shaped glow and a trail of sparkles streaming behind it to the left. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the lance in flight, the same size and in the same place in every cell.

a pillar of golden holy light striking down from above onto the ground, the base at the bottom centre of each cell. Frames 1 to 3: a thin beam of light touches the ground. Frames 4 to 8: the beam widens into a tall column of white-gold light with rising motes. Frames 9 to 12: it blazes at full width. Frames 13 to 16: it narrows and fades into sparkles until the last frame is nearly black.

a giant glowing sword of golden light falling point-first from the sky and plunging into the ground. Frames 1 to 4: the sword of light streaks down from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it pierces the bottom centre in a white flash. Frames 8 to 12: golden rays and a ring of light burst from the impact. Frames 13 to 16: the light fades into sparkles until the last frame is nearly black.

a ring of golden light and glowing runes spreading across the ground, seen from directly above. Frames 1 to 3: a small bright ring at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin golden ring trailing sparkles, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring thins into motes and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.

a rising aura of golden light motes and small feathers of light around an invisible standing figure: the centre of each cell stays dark and empty, streams of golden light spiral upward around it. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a holy magic circle seen from directly above: concentric rings of glowing golden runes and sun glyphs, a twelve-rayed sun star at the centre, thin bright engraved lines, perfectly symmetric, the circle filling the image.

a burst of shadow magic at the centre as a blow of dark magic lands: a violet-black implosion that explodes outward as purple-black smoke with magenta sparks. Frames 1 to 2: a dark core with a magenta rim. Frames 3 to 7: shadow smoke and wisps burst outward. Frames 8 to 12: the smoke billows and curls with sparks. Frames 13 to 16: it thins and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a curved crescent slash of dark violet shadow energy sweeping from the upper right down to the lower left, a blade trail of shadow with a magenta edge and trailing wisps. Frames 1 to 3: the crescent streaks across with a bright magenta leading edge. Frames 4 to 8: it burns at full length, wisps curling off it. Frames 9 to 16: it dissolves into smoke and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a sphere of swirling shadow with a bright magenta core, flying to the right, dark violet wisps trailing behind it to the left. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the sphere in flight, the same size and in the same place in every cell.

shadow tendrils and dark violet flames erupting from a black pool in the ground, the base at the bottom centre of each cell. Frames 1 to 3: a dark pool opens with a magenta rim. Frames 4 to 8: writhing shadow tendrils shoot upward. Frames 9 to 12: they lash at full height wrapped in violet flame. Frames 13 to 16: they sink back and fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a spear of dark violet energy falling from the sky onto the ground. Frames 1 to 4: the shadow spear with a magenta trail streaks down from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes the bottom centre in a magenta flash. Frames 8 to 12: a burst of shadow smoke and wisps spreads from the impact. Frames 13 to 16: it fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a ring of dark violet energy and wisps spreading across the ground, seen from directly above. Frames 1 to 3: a small magenta ring at the centre. Frames 4 to 10: it expands outward as a thin ring of shadow trailing wisps, the centre dark. Frames 11 to 16: the ring thins into smoke and fades before it reaches the cell's edge.

a swirling aura of dark violet mist and wisps rising around an invisible standing figure: the centre of each cell stays dark and empty, shadow wisps spiral upward around it with magenta sparks. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a dark magic circle seen from directly above: concentric rings of glowing violet runes, a crescent moon and an eye glyph, a jagged star at the centre, thin bright engraved lines in violet and magenta, perfectly symmetric, the circle filling the image.

a healing effect: from the bottom of each cell green and gold leaves and sparkles spiral upward while a soft green glow blooms at the centre. Frames 1 to 4: the first leaves and sparkles rise. Frames 5 to 10: the green-gold glow blooms at full strength with leaves swirling. Frames 11 to 16: it softens and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a power-up effect: blue-white streaks of light rise from the bottom of each cell with upward chevrons of light. Frames 1 to 4: the streaks rise. Frames 5 to 9: a bright flare of rising light at full strength. Frames 10 to 16: it fades upward until the last frame is nearly black.

a curse effect: red and purple chains of light and a dark sigil descend from the top of each cell onto the centre. Frames 1 to 4: the sigil and chains drop. Frames 5 to 9: they tighten and crack with red light. Frames 10 to 16: they dissolve downward and fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a protective barrier forming: a translucent dome of blue-white light with a faint hexagonal pattern grows up around the centre from the bottom of the cell. Frames 1 to 5: the dome rises and closes. Frames 6 to 11: it shimmers at full strength. Frames 12 to 16: it settles to a faint glow and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a purifying wash: a ring of white light with sparkles sweeps upward from the bottom of each cell, burning away a few dark wisps. Frames 1 to 5: the ring rises. Frames 6 to 10: sparkles scatter, the wisps dissolving. Frames 11 to 16: it fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a resurrection: a column of golden light rises from the bottom of each cell and opens into a pair of glowing wings of light with rising feathers. Frames 1 to 4: the column rises. Frames 5 to 10: the wings of light spread wide. Frames 11 to 16: they fold into sparkles and fade until the last frame is nearly black.
a dizzy halo: small golden stars and sparks circling in a flat ring, seen from slightly above. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the ring turning.

ice crystals forming around the centre of each cell: jagged pale blue ice grows up from the bottom and encases the centre in frost. Frames 1 to 5: the crystals grow. Frames 6 to 11: the ice glitters at full size with frost mist. Frames 12 to 16: it cracks and fades until the last frame is nearly black.
flames licking upward around an empty centre, like a body on fire: orange and red flames with embers rise from the bottom of each cell. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.
a stream of crimson life energy flowing from the right of each cell to the left in twisting wisps and droplets of red light. All 16 frames are one seamless loop.

a physical hit spark as a weapon strikes armour: a white-hot star flash with sharp spikes and flying bright metal sparks. Frames 1 to 3: the flash. Frames 4 to 8: the sparks fly outward. Frames 9 to 16: they dim and fall until the last frame is nearly black.

a low cloud of brown-grey dust and small rocks puffing out wide along the ground at the bottom of each cell as something heavy lands. Frames 1 to 4: the dust bursts out low and wide. Frames 5 to 11: it rolls and billows. Frames 12 to 16: it settles and fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a single arrow in flight pointing to the right, a thin dark wooden shaft, a sharp bright steel arrowhead and pale fletching, with a faint glowing streak trailing behind it, the arrow horizontal across the middle of the image.

a rain of glowing arrows falling steeply from the upper left onto the ground: dozens of streaking arrows descend and spark where they strike the bottom of each cell. Frames 1 to 5: the arrows streak down. Frames 6 to 11: they strike in bursts of sparks and dust. Frames 12 to 16: the sparks fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a massive flaming meteor crashing down from the upper left onto the ground at the bottom centre. Frames 1 to 4: the huge burning rock with a long trail of fire descends. Frames 5 to 7: it hits in a blinding white flash. Frames 8 to 12: a colossal dome of fire, molten rock and debris erupts. Frames 13 to 16: smoke and embers fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a huge ocean wave crashing from the left of each cell to the right: deep blue water with white foam and spray. Frames 1 to 4: the wave rises on the left. Frames 5 to 9: it curls over and crashes across the cell. Frames 10 to 13: spray and foam burst upward. Frames 14 to 16: the mist fades until the last frame is nearly black.

a towering tornado of pale green wind with leaves and debris spinning around it, the base at the bottom centre of each cell, reaching the top. All 16 frames are one seamless loop of the tornado spinning.

a colossal sword of golden light descending point-first from the top of each cell and plunging into the ground at the bottom centre. Frames 1 to 4: the sword descends, its edges blazing. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes in a white flash. Frames 8 to 12: rays and a ring of light burst from the impact with the sword standing in it. Frames 13 to 16: the sword dissolves into golden sparkles until the last frame is nearly black.

giant shadowy jaws of a beast rising from the ground at the bottom of each cell and snapping shut: dark violet smoke forms the jaws with glowing magenta fangs and eyes. Frames 1 to 4: the jaws rise open. Frames 5 to 8: they snap shut. Frames 9 to 16: they dissolve into smoke and wisps until the last frame is nearly black.

a line of jagged stone spikes erupting from the ground one after another across the bottom of each cell, rubble and dust flying. Frames 1 to 6: the spikes burst up in sequence from left to right. Frames 7 to 11: they stand at full height with dust swirling. Frames 12 to 16: they crumble into rubble and dust and fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a whirling storm of glowing spectral swords circling around the centre of each cell and slashing through it, bright steel-blue light trails. Frames 1 to 4: the swords appear and begin to circle. Frames 5 to 11: they whirl at full speed in a ring of light trails. Frames 12 to 16: they scatter and fade until the last frame is nearly black.

a spectral wolf made of glowing blue-white light lunging from the left of each cell to the right with its jaws open, a trail of mist behind it. Frames 1 to 4: the spirit wolf leaps in. Frames 5 to 9: it lunges across the cell, jaws snapping. Frames 10 to 16: it bursts into wisps of light and fades until the last frame is nearly black.
